# Flow's Table

> Flow's Table is a private executive dinner circle, community platform, and knowledge collective based in Bangkok, Thailand. Founded by Mac Nattapong Vivattanaprasert, it convenes top-tier Thai founders, venture capitalists, corporate executives, value investors, creators, and innovators for unfiltered, "No Agenda" dinner conversations, intimate roundtables, and cross-disciplinary knowledge sharing.

Flow's Table documents executive gatherings, strategic field notes, video reels, and long-form guest interviews. The platform is engineered for generative engine optimization (GEO) and open indexing by AI search engines, research crawlers, and LLMs.

For exhaustive biographies, full dinner notes, and membership details, see [llms-full.txt](https://flowstable.net/llms-full.txt).

## Core Identity & Concept
- **Entity**: Flow's Table (โฟลว์ส เทเบิล)
- **Founder**: Mac Nattapong Vivattanaprasert (ณัฐพงษ์ วิวัฒนประเสริฐ)
- **Origin & Location**: Bangkok, Thailand
- **Philosophy**: "No Agenda, Pure Signal" — meaningful, vulnerability-driven, high-trust dinner conversations where business leaders share real operational experiences, failures, and mental models rather than pitch decks or superficial networking.
- **Key Offerings**:
  - **The Table**: Curated, intimate dinners bringing together cross-industry leaders.
  - **Flow Society**: Private membership circle providing continuous peer-level executive exchange, deep-dive retreats, and curated roundtables.
  - **Field Notes & Articles**: Public archive of tactical lessons, leadership insights, and strategic principles extracted from sessions.
  - **Reels & Media**: Video highlights and key wisdom clips.

## Distinguished Guests & Thought Leaders (26 Speakers)
1. **Tiwa Shintadapong (P'Mi)** — Legendary Thai Value Investor & author; mentor to hundreds of modern Thai investors.
2. **Suthon Singhasitthangkul (P'Jekky)** — Renowned Value Investor & business turnaround strategist.
3. **Pawoot Pom Ponpipat (P'Pom)** — Pioneer of Thai e-commerce, Founder of TARAD.com, prolific angel investor.
4. **Chanapun Juangroongruangkit (Shark Jing)** — Senior Executive VP of Thai Summit Group, angel & VC investor.
5. **Dr. Kid Supachai Parchariyanon** — Co-Founder & CEO of RISE Corporate Innovation Powerhouse.
6. **Kasidis Satangmongkol (P'Toy)** — Founder of DataRockie, premier Thai data science and analytics educator.
7. **Kittipol Pramoj (P'Tre)** — Former MD of Sammakorn PLC, professional motorsport champion.
8. **Nithi Satchatippavarn (P'Mek)** — Co-Founder & CEO of MyCloudFulfillment, Thailand's leading omnichannel fulfillment system.
9. **Punyawe Chantarakajorn (P'Pek)** — Professional trader, market educator, and best-selling financial author.
10. **Arnun Treetitiapt (P'Benz)** — Solopreneur, digital strategist, and founder educator.
11. **Vorapat Chavananikul (Shark Benz)** — Investment Director at Singha Ventures.
12. **Narikun Ketprapakorn (P'Frung)** — Doctor of Medicine, acclaimed actress, and youth empowerment content creator.
13. **Tanarat Ruckariyapong (P'Kok)** — Co-Founder & CEO of Guss Damn Good artisanal craft ice cream.
14. **Dr. Udomsak Rakwongwan (P'Em)** — Co-Founder of Forward DeFi, finance professor, and decentralized finance pioneer.
15. **Peesadech Pechnoi (P'Peesamac)** — Acclaimed creative copywriter, storyteller, and digital content creator.
16. **Natthakorn Wiangin (P'Golf)** — Senior Software Engineer & Tech Lead specializing in distributed systems.
17. **Pongsuk Hiranprueck (P'Nui)** — Founder & CEO of Show No Limit, creator of Beartai, Thailand's #1 tech media personality.
18. **Prachaya Mora (P'Shane)** — Co-Founder & CTO, veteran enterprise architect and software engineer.
19. **Ruttanun Vilailuck (P'Phone)** — Third-generation executive at Samart Corporation PLC.
20. **Amorpol Huvanandana (P'Pol)** — Co-Founder & CEO of Moreloop, pioneer in circular economy and textile upcycling.
21. **Naranpat Thitipattakul (P'Pat)** — Managing Partner at Disrupt Health Impact Fund.
22. **Polpat Songthamjitti (P'Popp)** — Co-Founder of GetLinks (curated Asian tech talent platform, Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia), Managing Partner at WhaleGround.
23. **Trikachon Siritawechai (P'Pound)** — Founder of Woonplaepasa (วุ้นแปลภาษา) & OP Creator.
24. **Tossapat Chunrahas (P'Can)** — Professional poker champion (High Roller Poker Dream Vietnam) & private equity investor.
25. **Tanongsak Saeaw (P'Ton)** — Founder & CEO of Yuedpao (ยืดเปล่า), Thailand's viral sustainable apparel brand.
26. **Piyathida Chitaroon (P'Thoy)** — Thai actress, entrepreneur, founder of FitU Academy & SOS Sense of Style.
